input.quote: (b) In addition, either party may terminate this Agreement or any outstanding Statement of Work, upon fifteen (15) days written notice to the other party, in the event such other party breaches a material term of this Agreement or any Statement of Work and such breach remains uncured at the end of such fifteen (15) day period. Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination. Contractor shall provide to Company, and hereby assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
input.rationale: Section 6 (Termination) addresses only notice periods, payment of accrued fees and assignment of Works in progress; it contains no transition assistance, data return/export or deletion obligations. Section 4 covers ownership of Works but not their delivery or the return of Company data on exit, and the confidentiality provision (p0038–p0040) imposes only use/disclosure restrictions with no return-or-destroy mechanic. Searches for transition, export, deletion, return and copies found nothing relevant, so no usable clause exists anywhere in the Agreement. Recorded as missing and inserted the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, return within 30 days in machine-readable format, then certified deletion) as a new § 6(c); a 90-day assistance period is available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations in Section 6 (Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision because the Agreement is silent on what happens to our data and work in progress at termination: Contractor gives us up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then deletes and certifies deletion. We can accept a 90-day assistance period as a fallback.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days, return to Company all Works, Confidential Information and other data and materials of Company in Contractor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data and materials from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
